headline: RCR to acquire Robinsons Manila in P20-B share swap
summary: Robinsons Land Corp. will transfer Robinsons Manila to RL Commercial REIT in a P20.16 billion property-for-share swap. The deal adds nearly 104,000 square meters of gross leasable area to the REIT's portfolio, and both boards approved it on 20 November.
why: Robinsons Land is a major Philippine property developer, and RL Commercial REIT holds its retail properties. Property-for-share swaps shift assets between a developer and its listed REIT.
